description:
Help hundreds of engineers build, test, and ship software with confidence.

We are looking for a Build, Release & Infrastructure Engineer to own and improve the systems behind our large, multi-platform C++ codebase. You will make builds faster and more reliable, automate releases, and maintain the on-premises macOS and Linux infrastructure that supports development and testing.

Description
This is a hands-on engineering role: you will debug compilation and linking failures, improve CI pipelines, help drive our migration to Bazel, and work directly with compute fleets and lab hardware. You will partner with engineering teams across the organization and participate in a shared on-call rotation.

Responsibilities
CI/CD: Design, maintain, and monitor pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, and GitHub Actions. Improve build and test turnaround through caching, remote execution, and test sharding. Diagnose recurring failures and eliminate sources of instability.
Release engineering: Own release automation, including versioning, code signing and notarization, security scanning, packaging, and artifact distribution. Partner with engineering teams to define and maintain release gates, including sanitizer builds, regression suites, and coverage checks.
Build systems: Improve our C++ build infrastructure and help drive the migration from CMake/Make to Bazel. Develop and maintain toolchains and dependencies to make builds reproducible and hermetic across supported platforms.
Compute infrastructure: Plan capacity and automate provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of macOS and Linux machines and VMs using Ansible. Improve fleet availability, utilization, and observability.
Lab infrastructure: Maintain racks, test benches, and hardware-in-the-loop setups. Work with engineering teams to integrate hardware testing into CI.
Developer support and incident response: Troubleshoot build, CI, release, and compute issues alongside developers. Participate in on-call, restore service during incidents, and follow through with fixes, documentation, and automation that prevent recurrence.

Minimum qualifications
BS + 3 years of experience in build and release engineering, developer infrastructure, or a closely related DevOps role.
Strong understanding of C++ compilation, linking, and dependency management, with experience debugging CMake, Make, and Ninja builds.
Hands-on Bazel experience, including toolchains, hermetic builds, sandboxing, and remote caching.
Experience developing, operating, and troubleshooting production CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Ansible to provision and manage physical machines and VMs.
Strong Linux systems knowledge and working knowledge of macOS administration, including Xcode toolchains, launchd, and code signing.
Strong Python and Bash scripting skills.

Preferred qualifications
Clear communication, a collaborative approach to developer support, and the ability to prioritize effectively during incidents.
Experience migrating a large C++ codebase from CMake to Bazel.
Experience operating remote caching or execution infrastructure, such as BuildBarn, BuildBuddy, or Bazel RBE.
Experience authoring Starlark rules and managing dependencies with Bzlmod.
Experience managing Apple silicon fleets, including MDM and automated provisioning.
Familiarity with hardware test benches, serial consoles, and remote management tools such as IPMI or iDRAC.
Experience integrating C++ sanitizers, compiler caches such as ccache/sccache, or containerized build environments into development workflows.
